nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure: computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to detect overflow
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure: requires b <= a then computes c = a - b to detect underflow
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure: computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure: requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender at deployment
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) with onlyOwner modifier: stages newOwner
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then moves newOwner into owner and clears newOwner
BitcoinExchange constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address and emits Transfer
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits balances[msg.sender] with safeSub and credits balances[to] with safeAdd
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd on balances[to]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] then calls external spender.receiveApproval
Fallback function: payable, unconditionally revert() to reject ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: performs external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens)
address public owner: privileged owner set from msg.sender in Owned constructor
address public newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership
string public symbol, set to BEX in constructor
string public name, set to 'Bitcoin Exchange ' in constructor
uint8 public decimals, set to 18 in constructor
uint public _totalSupply: total minted supply
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balances per account
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, authentication and balance/allowance indexing
Arithmetic addition c = a + b in safeAdd guarded only by require(c >= a) overflow check
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b in safeSub guarded only by require(b <= a) underflow check
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b in safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
Arithmetic division c = a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0)
External call to an arbitrary user-supplied token contract via ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer
External callback ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval invoked by approveAndCall
